block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Master Viewport Sub-Domain Manifest orchestrating layout, scalers, themes, typography, and asset slots.
what_it_enables: Desktop viewport panel layout geometry and non-overlapping bounds
High-DPI font scaling coefficients across viewport resolutions
Master UI color themes across window chrome, backgrounds, and widgets
Functional typographic roles and font face bindings
Decoupled asset slot abstraction with generic engine identifiers
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations across viewport configuration (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
All viewport profiles must be 5-block compliant and statically verifiable
Procedural fallback floor: all presentation profiles guarantee non-blank rendering

profiles.title: Master Viewport & Display Settings Profile
profiles.description: Active display resolution preset, window mode, framerate, scaling, and theme selection.

profiles.title: High-DPI Font Scalers & Display Presets
profiles.description: Resolution presets ranging from 640x360 retro canvas to 4K Ultra HD.

profiles.title: Desktop Layout Geometry & Panel Coordinates
profiles.description: Non-overlapping AABB panel coordinates for header, viewport, status, chronicle, and dock.

profiles.title: Master UI Color Themes & Window Chrome
profiles.description: Color profiles for window chrome, panel backdrops, button shading, and text.

profiles.title: Typographic Hierarchy & Font Face Bindings
profiles.description: Font family declarations, base point sizes, line heights, and letter spacing.

profiles.title: Generic Asset Slot Registry & Procedural Fallbacks
profiles.description: Generic engine slots for protagonists, enemies, tiles, relics, and visual effects.

verification_tripwires.name: PROFILE_EXISTENCE
verification_tripwires.rule: All 6 viewport configuration profiles must exist on disk
